entries.title: Announcing the Agentic Catalog Experience in Amazon Quick
entries.content:
As organizations embrace AI-powered analytics, the value of a natural language (Text2SQL) answer is only as good as the business context behind it. We’re entering a phase where semantic richness (table and column descriptions, and relationships) must flow directly from where it’s authored in upstream data catalogs and semantic tools into the AI products that serve end users. Products like Amazon Quick can no longer operate in isolation. They need to natively consume and reason over the definitions, relationships, and governance metadata that data teams curate in systems like AWS Glue Data Catalog and Databricks Unity Catalog. This shift from siloed metadata to connected, catalog-aware AI is what enables intelligent analytics at scale.

## The challenge: Bridging the last mile

### The investment is done

Enterprise data teams have done the hard work. They have invested heavily in upstream catalog platforms such as AWS Glue, Databricks Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Collibra, and dbt. On these platforms, they meticulously define table descriptions, column semantics, primary and foreign key relationships, glossary terms, and metric definitions.

Yet when it comes to enabling end users (such as sales managers, marketing directors, and finance leads) for production-ready AI and trusted dashboards, a significant gap remains.

### Three compounding challenges

When data curators (business intelligence engineers, analytics leads, and senior analysts) need to enable their business users in Amazon Quick, they face three compounding challenges:

1. **Limited discoverability**: With thousands of tables in enterprise catalogs, discovering the right upstream assets that are curated and approved for reporting is a needle-in-a-haystack problem. There’s no way to describe what you need and have the system find it.
2. **Semantic fragmentation and manual recreation**: Rich metadata that already exists upstream (business descriptions on tables and columns, and primary and foreign key relationships) does not flow through. Curators must recreate assets from scratch, redefine descriptions, and reconcile definitions manually. Does “revenue” mean gross or net? Does “active customer” mean a purchase within 30 days or 90 days? These definitions exist upstream but require manual re-entry.
3. **Time to insight in weeks, not hours**: The combination of manual discovery and manual recreation means that the time from data to actionable insights stretches from hours to weeks. Worse, when upstream definitions change, manually created semantics in Quick Datasets become stale, causing semantic drift that erodes trust in AI answers and dashboards over time.

### The gap

The problem isn’t upstream. The metadata exists. The governance is defined. The relationships are mapped.

The problem is the last mile: translating that rich catalog context into a curated, consumable experience that delivers grounded AI answers and deterministic dashboards end users can trust.

## Introducing the Agentic Catalog Experience in Amazon Quick

Today, we’re announcing the Agentic Catalog Experience in Amazon Quick, an AI-powered workflow that helps data curators rapidly define their context boundary, inherit upstream semantics, and enable end users for grounded Q&A and trusted dashboards at scale.

At the heart of this experience is the Quick Agent, scoped to discovery, creation, and inheritance tasks within the catalog context. It uses the semantic context from the catalog connection to summarize the entire catalog at a glance, engage the customer in natural language conversation, surface the most relevant tables and relationships based on the customer’s use case, and assess metadata readiness. Then, with a single conversational confirmation, it auto-creates Catalog-Generated Datasets and Topics with targeted metadata inherited from the upstream catalog.

**No manual configuration. No context-switching. No weeks of setup.**

![](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/f1f836cb4ea6efb2a0b1b99f41ad8b103eff4b59/2026/07/31/AgenticCatalogExperience.png)

## How it works

### Natural language asset discovery

Instead of scrolling through thousands of tables to find the right ones, curators use natural language. With the Agentic Catalog Experience, curators describe what they need:

> Curator: “I’m a Senior Analyst on the Finance team. I need tables for quarterly revenue reporting and cost analysis.”

The Quick Agent searches across your entire catalog to surface the most relevant tables instantly, using all available metadata including business descriptions, tags, Gold/Silver/Bronze classifications, quality scores, table health scores, and glossary terms. No more manual browsing. No more guessing.

### Bulk agentic dataset creation

After the curator selects their tables, the Quick Agent creates catalog representations (Datasets) at scale in a single guided workflow. Your upstream catalog remains the source of truth because the default creation path is Direct Query. Datasets with inherited semantics are flagged with a clear “Semantics Inherited” badge, and their metadata is read-only. Authors can refresh inherited metadata on demand by choosing the sync button to stay aligned with their catalog.

> Quick Agent: “Creating 6 Catalog-Generated Datasets now: `revenue_by_region` created (DirectQuery, read-only metadata), `cost_centers` created, and `gl_transactions` created.”

### Semantic and relationship inheritance

The Quick Agent carries forward targeted metadata from your catalog into the assets it creates. Today, inheritance is deliberately focused on two key areas to avoid noise and keep Datasets clean:

* **Table and column definitions to Datasets**: Business descriptions and column definitions are inherited directly into the created Datasets, so that curators and end users have the semantic context they need.
* **Primary and foreign key relationships to Topics**: The Agent detects relationships and uses them to suggest and create multi-dataset constructs (Topics) with star and snowflake schema joins preconfigured.

**Note**: While all available metadata (Gold/Silver classifications, quality scores, tags, and health scores) is used during discovery to find the right tables, inheritance into Datasets is intentionally scoped to table and column definitions today. We plan to add more metadata types to Datasets over time.

> Quick Agent: “I detected 3 relationships between these tables and created a Topic called ‘Finance Revenue Model’ with the star schema joins preconfigured. Table and column definitions have been inherited from the upstream catalog.”

### Immediate consumption

The curated Datasets and Topics are ready for use immediately:

* **Ask questions**: Start a Q&A conversation with your new Datasets. The AI agent uses inherited business descriptions, glossary terms, and quality scores to deliver grounded answers.
* **Create dashboards**: Build deterministic visualizations with full semantic context already in place.
* **Share with end users**: Add Datasets to a Space and share them with business users for self-service Q&A.

After creation, the metadata tied to these Datasets and Topics feeds into the Amazon Quick semantic store, which powers re-ranking and unified context for AI-powered Q&A. Getting from catalog connection to the first business question takes minutes, not weeks.

## Architecture: Consumer, not catalog

A key design principle underpins this experience: Amazon Quick is a consumer of upstream catalog metadata, not a dedicated catalog itself. This means:

* **No data duplication**: Catalog-Generated Datasets use DirectQuery. No data is copied or moved.
* **Metadata consumed for context**: Inherited semantics are read-only in Amazon Quick and flow into the semantic store to power re-ranking and AI answer grounding. Your upstream catalog remains the authoritative source.
* **Manual semantic sync**: Authors can refresh inherited metadata on demand by choosing the sync button. Scheduled automatic sync is on the roadmap.
* **Extensibility with transparency**: Catalog-Generated Datasets show inherited semantics as read-only (marked as catalog representations). If an Author chooses to edit a Dataset, Amazon Quick provides a clear notification that editing creates a custom Dataset and that semantic sync no longer applies. This gives Authors full control while preserving catalog integrity by default.

### Supported catalogs today

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Catalog platform** | **Authentication** |
| AWS Glue Data Catalog | AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Role ARN |
| Databricks Unity Catalog | OAuth 2.0 / Personal Access Token |

Support for additional catalog platforms is coming soon.

### What gets inherited

Metadata inheritance is intentionally focused to keep Datasets clean and production-ready:

#### Into Datasets (table and column definitions)

* Table business and technical descriptions.
* Column descriptions and display names.
* Data types and nullability.
* Glossary terms and synonyms.

#### Into Topics (relationships)

* Primary and foreign key relationships.
* Relationship definitions and cardinality.
* Star and snowflake schema models.

## The end-user experience

Here’s what this means for the business users downstream:

> A sales manager asks: “What were our Q4 sales by region?”

Behind the scenes, the AI agent:

1. Searches Catalog-Generated Datasets using business descriptions and glossary terms.
2. Identifies the `sales.revenue_by_product` table (Gold, 98 percent quality).
3. Applies preconfigured joins from the Topic to combine relevant dimensions.
4. Respects personally identifiable information (PII) masking rules from catalog metadata.
5. Returns a grounded, trusted answer in seconds.

No manual dataset configuration required. The curator defined the context boundary once with the Quick Agent, and every end user benefits immediately.

### Unified enterprise context

The Agentic Catalog Experience doesn’t exist in isolation. Combined with the broader platform capabilities of Amazon Quick (including integration with Slack, Outlook, documents, and knowledge bases), end users get the full enterprise context:

* **Structured data** from catalogs through Catalog-Generated Datasets.
* **Unstructured context** from documents, email messages, and conversations.
* **Business rules** from glossary terms and metric definitions.

This unified context enables production-ready AI answers, grounded in your organization’s specific data and semantics.

### Connecting to AWS Glue Data Catalog

To get started with the Agentic Catalog Experience, create a data source connection to your AWS Glue Data Catalog in Amazon Quick. After you establish the connection, the Quick Agent guides you through discovery, schema exploration, and Topic creation in a single conversational workflow. In this walkthrough, we connect to a Glue Data Catalog and build a Financial Analytics Topic.

In Amazon Quick, create a new data source. From the list of connection types, select **Glue Data Catalog** (available in preview), and then choose **Next**. This connection is for the metadata. With it, Amazon Quick can consume the table and column definitions and the relationships your teams have already curated in AWS Glue.

![Amazon Quick new data source page with Glue Data Catalog selected from the connection types](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/f1f836cb4ea6efb2a0b1b99f41ad8b103eff4b59/2026/07/31/ML-21554-1.png)

Figure 1: Selecting the Glue Data Catalog connection type in Amazon Quick

A Glue Data Catalog connection works together with an Amazon Athena connection. Glue provides the metadata, and Athena provides the query path to the data itself in Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3). Create the Athena data source as well, so that Amazon Quick can run queries against the underlying data. After you create both, the Data sources page shows the two entries side by side: the Glue Data Catalog source for the metadata and the Athena source for the data.

![Amazon Quick Data sources page showing the Glue Data Catalog and Amazon Athena connections side by side](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/f1f836cb4ea6efb2a0b1b99f41ad8b103eff4b59/2026/07/31/ML-21554-2.png)

Figure 2: The Glue Data Catalog and Athena data sources listed together

Open the GDC-Demo data source detail page. Under **Data connections**, you can see the linked Athena data source that Amazon Quick uses to query the data. Choose **Explore data** to launch the Quick Agent scoped to this data source.

![GDC-Demo data source detail page with the linked Athena connection and the Explore data option](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/f1f836cb4ea6efb2a0b1b99f41ad8b103eff4b59/2026/07/31/ML-21554-3.png)

Figure 3: Launching the Quick Agent from the data source detail page

The Quick Agent panel opens on the right side of the screen, automatically scoped to the Glue Data Catalog data source. The “Specific data” mode is selected, with “GDC-Demo” pinned as the context boundary. As a result, the Agent surfaces only metadata from this specific catalog connection.

![Quick Agent panel scoped to the GDC-Demo Glue Data Catalog data source in Specific data mode](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/f1f836cb4ea6efb2a0b1b99f41ad8b103eff4b59/2026/07/31/ML-21554-4.png)

Figure 4: The Quick Agent scoped to a specific catalog connection

Ask the Agent to explore your catalog. The Agent summarizes the available catalogs and databases at a glance, so you can quickly see what is curated in your Glue Data Catalog. For this post, we use the “fa-demo” database as our example, a Finance Analytics Demo star schema for banking analytics. This walkthrough illustrates how the feature works and is not an exact scenario, so you can apply the same steps to your own catalog.

![Quick Agent summarizing the catalogs and databases available in the Glue Data Catalog](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/f1f836cb4ea6efb2a0b1b99f41ad8b103eff4b59/2026/07/31/ML-21554-5.png)

Figure 5: The Agent summarizing available catalogs and databases

Ask the Agent to explore the fa-demo database. The Agent identifies a classic star schema with 7 tables: 2 fact tables (`fact_transactions` and `fact_loans`) and 5 dimension tables (`dim_account`, `dim_date_transactions`, `dim_date_loans`, `dim_merchant`, and `dim_txn_category`). All are stored as external tables in Amazon S3. The Agent recognizes the schema as covering customer account transactions and loan portfolios, with supporting dimensions for merchants, transaction categories, and date hierarchies.

![Quick Agent describing the fa-demo star schema with two fact tables and five dimension tables](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/f1f836cb4ea6efb2a0b1b99f41ad8b103eff4b59/2026/07/31/ML-21554-6.png)

Figure 6: The Agent identifying the fact and dimension tables in the fa-demo database

Ask the Agent to create a star schema diagram for fa-demo. The Agent analyzes the tables, identifies the primary and foreign key relationships, and presents a complete logical data model with a schema summary. It highlights that `dim_account` is the shared conformed dimension connecting both fact tables. Choose **Create datasets & Topic** to let the Agent build everything automatically.

![Star schema diagram generated by the Quick Agent showing dim_account connecting both fact tables](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/f1f836cb4ea6efb2a0b1b99f41ad8b103eff4b59/2026/07/31/ML-21554-7.png)

Figure 7: The generated logical data model for the fa-demo schema

The Agent creates a fully configured Topic with all Datasets and relationships in place. In this example, it creates the “Financial Analytics” Topic with all seven Datasets from the fa-demo database and 6 preconfigured star schema joins. Each Dataset carries its inherited business description, and the join relationships between the fact and dimension tables are validated automatically. The Topic is immediately ready for natural language Q&A, so you can ask questions like “What is the total transaction amount by merchant category?” or “Show me delinquent loans by risk rating.”

![Quick Agent showing the Financial Analytics Topic with seven Datasets and six preconfigured joins](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/f1f836cb4ea6efb2a0b1b99f41ad8b103eff4b59/2026/07/31/ML-21554-8.png)

Figure 8: The fully configured Financial Analytics Topic

Now, let’s see how the Financial Analytics Topic created from the Glue Data Catalog works in action. With the Topic pinned as context, end users can ask questions in plain language and get grounded answers instantly. For example, a user can ask “Total transaction amount by merchant category” and the Agent returns a ranked breakdown with key highlights. The user can then follow up with “Delinquent loans by risk rating” to see a risk-level summary with insights. Because the Datasets and relationships were inherited from the catalog, every answer is backed by the trusted schema, joins, and business definitions defined upstream. This is the power of the Agentic Catalog Experience: curators define the context boundary once, and every end user can explore the data conversationally from there.

![Animation of a user asking questions and the Quick Agent returning ranked answers from the Financial Analytics Topic](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/artifacts/DBSBlogs/ML-21554/ML-21554-9.gif)

Figure 9: Asking natural language questions against the Financial Analytics Topic

### Connecting to Databricks Unity Catalog

The same experience works with Databricks Unity Catalog. Here is a quick example that shows the full flow, from configuring the connection to creating Datasets and a Topic.

Create a Databricks Unity Catalog data source, and then choose **Explore data** to launch the Quick Agent. The Agent summarizes the catalog, and with a single confirmation it creates the Datasets and a Topic with the star schema joins already configured.

![Animation of creating Databricks Unity Catalog Datasets and a Topic through the Quick Agent](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/artifacts/DBSBlogs/ML-21554/ML-21554-10.gif)

Figure 10: Creating Datasets and a Topic from Databricks Unity Catalog

After the Topic is ready, end users can ask complex questions that span multiple related tables. In this example, the Agent answers “Top 5 brands by revenue per region” by joining across the Topic relationships, and returns a grounded, visual result.

![Animation of the Quick Agent answering a multi-table question about top brands by revenue per region](https://d2908q01vomqb2.cloudfront.net/f1f836cb4ea6efb2a0b1b99f41ad8b103eff4b59/2026/07/31/ML-21554-11.gif)

Figure 11: Answering a multi-table question across Topic relationships

## The result

Curators deliver trusted data, full enterprise context, and production-ready AI answers and dashboards in a fraction of the time. End users get grounded answers they can trust, backed by Gold-standard data with full semantic lineage.

**From weeks of manual configuration to minutes of guided conversation.**

*That’s the Agentic Catalog Experience in Amazon Quick.*

---

entries.title: Humans count the boxes in this image, hidden ones included, with 82.1% accuracy. The best off-the-sh...
entries.content:
Humans count the boxes in this image, hidden ones included, with 82.1% accuracy. The best off-the-shelf multimodal model manages 17.7%.  
  
Spatial-IQ is a diagnostic benchmark from NVIDIA Research that breaks 3D object counting into nine perceptual and cognitive sub-tasks, from counting columns to inferring the blocks that must be underneath to hold the structure up, and scores each one separately. Training on those sub-tasks lifted Qwen2.5-VL-32B object-counting accuracy from 2.9% to 62.6%.  
  
For researchers developing multimodal reasoning systems, this creates a practical loop: identify where spatial reasoning fails, target the missing capability, and verify that improvement reflects composition, not just a better final score.

entries.title: Oxide and Friends: The Open Weight Revolution with Simon Willison
entries.content:
**[Oxide and Friends: The Open Weight Revolution with Simon Willison](https://oxide-and-friends.transistor.fm/episodes/the-open-weight-revolution-with-simon-willison)**

On Monday Bryan Cantrill and Adam Leventhal invited me to join their podcast to talk about the *wild* week we've had - with Kimi K3 showing open weight models can stand toe-to-toe with proprietary frontier ones, [accidental cybersecurity attacks](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jul/22/openai-cyberattack/), and public letters about [Open Weights and American AI Leadership](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/corporate-responsibility/topics/open-weight/) signed by almost every big name in AI (with one [notable exception](https://www.anthropic.com/news/position-open-weights-models)).

It was a great conversation, even though it's already out-of-date! [DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/deepseek-v4-flash) and [Anthropic's own embarrassing cyber incident](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jul/30/three-real-world-incidents/) would absolutely have made the cut if we had recorded just a few days later.

We also talk about [Golden Gate Claude](https://www.anthropic.com/news/golden-gate-claude), the [Zizians](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zizians), [Alameda wild turkey attacks](https://abc7news.com/post/83-year-old-alameda-woman-attacked-wild-turkeys-city-warns-residents-take-precautions-during-mating-season/19190785/), [Soviet Marburg virus research](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soviet_biological_weapons_program), the [Lead-crime hypothesis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lead–crime_hypothesis), and a bunch of other worthy digressions.

Finally, we revisited some of [our predictions from January](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jan/8/llm-predictions-for-2026/), and we [added a new Pope prediction](https://simonwillison.net/2026/May/25/encyclical-on-ai/#another-2026-prediction-down):

> Prediction by the end of this year: the Pope says something about open models.

entries.title: smevals - a small eval suite for evaluating models, prompts, and harnesses
entries.content:
**[smevals - a small eval suite for evaluating models, prompts, and harnesses](https://primeradiant.com/blog/2026/smevals.html)**

I've been working with Jesse Vincent's [Prime Radiant](https://primeradiant.com) applied AI research lab building out this evals framework to help answer questions about the capabilities of different models.

The result is **[smevals](https://github.com/prime-radiant-inc/smevals)**, a new tool for running small eval suites across different model configurations and grading the results.

This blog entry describes the tool in detail. Here's the 10 second version:

1. Tell your coding agent to `run uvx smevals docs` to learn the tool (this outputs [the README](https://github.com/prime-radiant-inc/smevals/blob/main/README.md))
2. Then tell it to build you an eval suite

Once you've created an eval - which takes the form of a directory with some YAML files - you can run it against models like this:

```
uvx smevals run path-to-eval/ -m gpt-5.5 -m claude-opus-4.6
```

Runs are treated separately from grading operations - you can grade your runs (against your defined set of checks) using:

```
uvx smevals grade path-to-eval/
```

Then you can run a localhost web server to explore the results:

```
uvx smevals serve path-to-eval/
```

Or run the `smevals build` command to build that report as static HTML, which you can then host anywhere. Here's [an example](https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/smevals-haiku-build/#/haiku) showing an eval suite I built to evaluate how well models can write haikus.

![Screenshot of an evaluation dashboard for a haiku-writing benchmark, testing whether models can reply with exactly three non-empty lines. A header describes the eval, with panels below showing a leaderboard ranking three GPT models by score, lists of recent runs and recent grades, tag pass rates, the two haiku prompts that were tested, and details of the graders used with a 0.8 pass threshold.](https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/smevals-report.webp)

I've been trying to figure out an approach I like for evals for several years now. `smevals` is my third iteration on the idea and it feels right to me. I'm looking forward to expanding this more in the future, as well as pointing it at some of my own projects.

Tags: [projects](https://simonwillison.net/tags/projects), [ai](https://simonwillison.net/tags/ai), [generative-ai](https://simonwillison.net/tags/generative-ai), [llms](https://simonwillison.net/tags/llms), [llm](https://simonwillison.net/tags/llm), [evals](https://simonwillison.net/tags/evals), [jesse-vincent](https://simonwillison.net/tags/jesse-vincent)

entries.title:
Everyone’s going on about how smart Leopold Aschennbrenner is (or was).

But

1. He obviously didn’t...
entries.content:
Everyone’s going on about how smart Leopold Aschennbrenner is (or was).  
  
But  
  
1. He obviously didn’t know anything at all about risk management. (Or arrogantly chose to disregard whatever he might have been told). He also worked for a while for SBF which I see as perhaps a second error in judgement.  
  
2. He completely failed to factor in what might happen if LLMs turned out to be commodity, even though people like me warned for years that would likely happen.  
  
3. So far all the rise in the LLM industry has been on hope, rather than actual return for the LLM companies. His fund’s biggest remaining hope is their chunk of Anthropic, but it is still unclear whether Anthropic can find a sustainable business model.  
  
LA/SALP certainly made big, bold bets, and some of them were golden in the short-term, until they weren’t.   
  
Whether they were correct long term (aside from his recently being squeezed) remains to be seen.

As teams move fas...
entries.content:
"Systems thinking" has now come up on the last five podcast interviews I've done.  
  
As teams move faster and products get more complex, the ability to think about the big picture, build platforms and building blocks, and think about 2nd and 3rd order effects of your changes becomes more and more valuable.

![Lenny Rachitsky](https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1592990461517389824/iln8hi1f_normal.jpg)

Lenny Rachitsky@lennysan

entries.title:
Neat work on long-horizon agents.

Splitting a hard task across agents is typically how standard mul...
entries.content:
Neat work on long-horizon agents.  
  
Splitting a hard task across agents is typically how standard multi-agent work. The usual design lets them exchange findings only at phase boundaries, through staged handoffs or synchronized rounds, so communication and work stay mutually exclusive.  
  
AgentRadio breaks that constraint with an asynchronous message-passing layer. Three primitives, threads, messages, and waiting for mentions. The last one runs as a background task, surfacing a teammate's discovery without interrupting foreground work.  
  
On SWE-Atlas QnA, a single Claude Code agent on Opus 4.6 resolves 32.3% of tasks. Four agents wired through AgentRadio resolve 62.1%. That also beats a single Claude Code agent running the newer Opus 4.8 at 57.2%.  
  
Rubric-level analysis shows the gain growing with task difficulty, which points at mid-course correction as the mechanism rather than raw parallelism.  
  
Paper: [arxiv.org/abs/2607.28430](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28430)  
  
Track more trending AI papers in our academy: [academy.dair.ai](https://academy.dair.ai/)

![Tweet Image](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HOlX1JCacAAd-Kb.jpg)

entries.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
entries.content:
**[deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731)**

The latest release in DeepSeek's V4 family, "with substantially enhanced agentic capabilities". It's 304 billion parameters - 167GB on Hugging Face - but it appears to punch *well* above its weight.

Artificial Analysis [rank it](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/deepseek-v4-flash) ahead of MiniMax M3 - a 428B model. It's $0.14/million input and $0.27/million output pricing means this may currently be the best value-per-intelligence model out there. It's looking very good on the [Intelligence Index vs. Cost per Intelligence Index Task](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/deepseek-v4-flash#intelligence-comparison-tabs) chart:

![Scatter plot from Artificial Analysis titled with axes "Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index" (20 to 65) and "Cost per Task (USD, Log Scale)" ($0.02 to $3), with a green "Most attractive quadrant" box in the upper left and a dotted "Pareto line". DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 (max) is highlighted in dark blue at roughly $0.028 and an intelligence score of 50, sitting alone at the far left edge of the green quadrant where the Pareto line jumps sharply upward. Models of similar or lower intelligence like MiniMax-M3, Kimi K3 (low), GLM-5.1 and Kimi K2.6 cost ten times more, and the models that beat it (Grok 4.5, Gemini 3.6 Flash, GLM-5.2, Kimi K3, Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol) all sit far to the right at $0.4 to $3 per task.](https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/deepseek-flash-chart.webp)

I got [a disappointing pelican](https://gist.github.com/simonw/83bfb1171792f1e7a4d8935b5e82317e#prompt) from it using the default reasoning level via OpenRouter:

![Flat vector illustration of a white pelican with a long neck and large orange beak pouch, hovering above a mangled blue and orange bicycle on a dark grey road with white dashed lane markings. The bike is drawn incorrectly: the wheels are just orange arcs with no rims or spokes, the frame tubes float apart and the handlebars connect to nothing. The background is pale blue with a yellow sun in the upper left, white clouds, and grey speed lines on the left suggesting motion.](https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/deepseek-flash-v4-default.png)

But when I bumped reasoning level up to high I got [something much better](https://gist.github.com/simonw/83bfb1171792f1e7a4d8935b5e82317e#options):

`llm -m openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 -t pelican -o reasoning_effort high`

![Flat vector illustration of a white pelican riding a bicycle to the right against a pink background with a lighter pink circle behind it. The pelican grips the handlebars with its wings and one orange foot rests on the pedal, and a small blue fish is visible tucked in the corner of its large orange beak pouch. The bike has a red, blue and orange frame with dark tires, and grey speed lines trail behind to suggest motion.](https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/deepseek-flash-v4-high.png)

Via [Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49120299)

entries.title: Stateless MCP has recaptured my interest (and inspired mcp-explorer and datasette-mcp)
entries.content:
Tuesday was [Stateless MCP day](https://x.com/ade_oshineye/status/2082129440943866149) - the rollout of MCP 2.0, or [the 2026-07-28 Model Context Protocol specification](https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2026-07-28/) to use the more formal but less memorable name. This is the most significant change to the MCP spec since it first launched, and has also served to reignite my personal interest in the protocol.

For background: MCP is the Model Context Protocol, which describes a standard way to expose new tools to LLM-powered agent frameworks. It was introduced by Anthropic back [in November 2024](https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-context-protocol), had a *huge* spike of interest through much of 2025, and then became somewhat eclipsed by [Skills](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Oct/16/claude-skills/) (another Anthropic invention) when it became apparent that an agent harness with access to a terminal and `curl` could do most of what MCP did in a more flexible way. I wrote about that [in my review of 2025](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Dec/31/the-year-in-llms/#the-only-year-of-mcp).

I'm coming back around to MCP now. Giving an agent a shell environment with the ability to access the internet is [fraught with risk](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jul/22/openai-cyberattack/), and requires a strong model that is capable of effectively driving such an environment. MCP tools are easier to audit and control, and simple enough that smaller models that run on a laptop can still drive them reasonably well.

The new stateless MCP specification also greatly decreases the complexity of implementing both clients and servers for the protocol. I built three of those this week!

#### What's easier with stateless MCP

The best demonstration of the difference between stateful and stateless MCP is in this [May 21st blog post](https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2026-07-28-release-candidate/) that introduced the RC for the new specification. It included a clear before-and-after example.

The older stateful MCP (I'm going to call it "legacy MCP") required two HTTP requests - the first to initialize a session and obtain a `Mcp-Session-Id`, and the second to actually call the tool:

```
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "initialize",
  "params": {
    "protocolVersion": "2025-11-25",
    "capabilities": {
    },
    "clientInfo": {
      "name": "my-app",
      "version": "1.0"
    }
  }
}

POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Mcp-Session-Id: 1868a90c-3a3f-4f5b
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 2,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "search",
    "arguments": {
      "q": "otters"
    }
  }
}
```

The new stateless way uses a single HTTP request which looks like this:

```
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
MCP-Protocol-Version: 2026-07-28
Mcp-Method: tools/call
Mcp-Name: search
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "search",
    "arguments": {
      "q": "otters"
    },
    "_meta": {
      "io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo": {
        "name": "my-app",
        "version": "1.0"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

This is so much cleaner from both a client- and server-side implementation perspective. It's also a better fit for building scalable web applications, since now you don't need to maintain server-side state to keep track of those session IDs, or worry about routing the same session to the same backend machine.

#### mcp-explorer

I couldn't find a great CLI tool for interactively probing an MCP server, so I had Codex help build my own.

**[mcp-explorer](https://github.com/simonw/mcp-explorer)** is the result. It's a stateless Python CLI tool, so you don't even need to install it to try it out - it works with [uvx](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/tools/#running-tools) like this:

```
uvx mcp-explorer list https://agentic-mermaid.dev/mcp
```

This queries Ade Oshineye's [agentic-mermaid.dev](https://agentic-mermaid.dev/) demo MCP. The above command returns the following list of tools:

```
execute(code: string, timeoutMs?: integer) - Execute Mermaid SDK code
  Run JavaScript in an isolated sandbox; return a value.

describe_sdk(family: string, detail?: string) - Describe Mermaid SDK operations
  Return version-matched mutation operations for one diagram family.

render_svg(source: string, options?: object) - Render Mermaid as SVG
  Render a Mermaid source string to themeable SVG. Returns { ok, svg }.

render_ascii(source: string, useAscii?: boolean, targetWidth?: integer, options?: object) - Render Mermaid as text
  Render a Mermaid source string to text. Returns { ok, text }.

render_png(source: string, scale?: number, background?: string, fitTo?: object, options?: object) - Render Mermaid as PNG
  Rasterize a Mermaid source string to PNG. Returns { ok, png_base64 }.
...
```

Then to inspect a tool:

```
uvx mcp-explorer inspect render_svg
```

This outputs a whole bunch of information, including the JSON schema of the inputs and outputs.

To call that tool and pass arguments to it:

```
uvx mcp-explorer call \
  https://agentic-mermaid.dev/mcp \
  render_svg \
  -a source 'graph TD; A-->B' \
  -a options '{"padding":24}'
```

Which returns:

```
{"ok":true,"svg":"<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=...
```

To get just the raw SVG try adding `| jq .svg -r` to that command. I got back [this image](https://gist.github.com/simonw/b07c62f0ce103be6932477659d5dd1ac):

![SVG of as A box on top of a B box with an arrow from A to B](https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/mermaid-example.svg)

There are a [few more commands](https://github.com/simonw/mcp-explorer/blob/main/README.md) in the README, but you get the general idea. I find building CLI tools like this to be a really productive way to get familiar with a specification, even if an agent writes most of the actual code.

#### datasette-mcp

The second project is **[datasette-mcp](https://github.com/datasette/datasette-mcp)**, a Datasette plugin which adds a `/-/mcp` endpoint to any Datasette instance.

This is probably the fourth time I've tried building this plugin, but thanks to the new stateless MCP specification I finally have a version that feels good to release.

It provides just three tools: `list_databases()`, `get_database_schema(database_name)`, and `execute_sql(database_name, sql)`. They do exactly what you would expect them to do - though `execute_sql()` is read-only for the moment.

Wire these into an agent, or a chat tool like ChatGPT or Claude, and they'll gain the ability to run SQL queries against your hosted Datasette instance.

So far I'm running it on the Datasette mirror of my blog, at <datasette.simonwillison.net/-/mcp>. It took a bit of fiddling to figure out how to attach that to ChatGPT and Claude, but I got there in the end. Here's [a new TIL](https://til.simonwillison.net/llms/mcp-in-claude-and-chatgpt) showing exactly how to do that.

Here's [a shared Claude session](https://claude.ai/share/de1ad9bf-f7c2-4fb9-a9a0-2a1ae39995db) where I asked it:

> `list tables in simonwillison.net`

And then:

> `what has Simon said recently about MCP?`

It ran 7 separate SQL queries to figure out the answer.

#### llm-mcp-client

My [LLM tool](https://llm.datasette.io/) is long overdue for an official MCP integration. The new alpha [llm-mcp-client](https://github.com/simonw/llm-mcp-client) plugin is my attempt at exactly that:

```
llm install llm-mcp-client
llm -T 'MCP("https://datasette.simonwillison.net/-/mcp")' 'count the notes'
```

Here's the output (including reasoning trace, I'm using [LLM 0.32rc2](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jul/30/llm-rc2/)):

> ***Considering note count***
>
> *I see the question "count the notes" is probably asking me to tally up blog notes. It could also mean published notes or drafts, so there's some ambiguity there. I'll need to figure out the total number of notes, likely by querying the count for both published notes and drafts to get a clear answer. Let's execute that count!*
>
> There are **151 notes**.

And [the output of llm logs](https://gist.github.com/simonw/4e8f558766150658ce35eab4f0fc3e04) for that prompt.

Once this is fully baked, I'm considering bringing it directly into LLM core. I'm excited to experiment with MCP in [Datasette Agent](https://agent.datasette.io/) and [llm-coding-agent](https://github.com/simonw/llm-coding-agent) as well.

#### MCP is a safer way to build with agents

A few months after MCP was first released, I wrote [Model Context Protocol has prompt injection security problems](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Apr/9/mcp-prompt-injection/), where I noted that the pattern of having end users mix and match tools pushed responsibility for avoiding data exfiltration attacks out to the users themselves. I hadn't coined [the Lethal Trifecta](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Jun/16/the-lethal-trifecta/) yet, but that was absolutely what I had in mind.

Then general agents with arbitrary shell and `curl` access came along, and that's so much harder to keep secure!

Something I've come to appreciate about MCP is that it's much easier to reason about agent capabilities and what might go wrong than with arbitrary command execution in an open network environment - the default for most of today's general and coding agent tools.

I plan to lean into MCP a whole lot more when I'm building sensitive applications on top of LLMs.

entries.content:
什么😧？7月30 日 苹果交出了一份财报数据贼棒的数据，但股价大跌！  
  
苹果业绩大超预期，股价却跌了，核心原因就一个：存储芯片涨价涨到连库克都快扛不住了。  
  
营收1094亿美元，净利近300亿，iPhone和Mac增速都很高。  
  
但库克在电话会上直接说，现在是“百年一遇的存储定价洪水”，价格呈指数级上涨，9月财季成本还会继续攀升。  
  
苹果已经先把Mac和iPad涨了价，有的型号涨幅接近20%。  
  
更关键的是，库克明确表示正在评估所有供应来源。  
  
此前已有消息称苹果在游说美国政府，希望能用长鑫的DRAM和长江存储的NAND，缓解成本和供应压力。  
  
美光则强烈反对，警告一旦放开，可能冲击美国本土存储产业。  
  
当全球最会控制供应链的公司都开始公开喊“洪水”，并认真考虑引入中国存储厂商时，说明这轮涨价已经动到了苹果的利润根基。  
  
人们对于股价更多的是未来的叙事，而苹果恰恰不具备这个点。直接跌破5万亿美金。  
  
并且这个季度的数据以及我们所真实体验是还是有明显的下滑，看看全球的表现了

entries.content:
阿里巴巴的这个Agent 还挺有意思的啊～  
  
阿里把手机、电脑、浏览器操作统一进一个GUI Agent里了。  
  
Qwen-UI-Agent是一个面向真实场景的基础GUI智能体，把移动端、电脑、浏览器以及DeepSearch能力整合进同一个模型。  
  
它通过在超过1万个并行环境中做在线强化学习训练，目标是真正能跨设备、跨界面完成复杂操作。  
  
以前GUI Agent往往各自为政：有的擅长手机，有的擅长网页，有的只能处理桌面。  
  
现在用一个模型统一覆盖多种界面，再加上搜索能力，等于在向“一个Agent搞定所有屏幕操作”的方向推进。  
  
当模型开始在大规模真实并行环境中用在线RL学习跨端操作时，通用计算机使用能力的上限会被重新拉开。

ChatGPT开始真正长进浏览器里了。  
  
Chrome扩展现在支持侧边栏直接问当前YouTube视频、引用你打开的标签页，或者高亮网页文字后立刻提问。  
  
桌面端则能在输入时给出URL建议，并回顾浏览器历史。  
  
高亮一段文字，右键选“Ask ChatGPT”，侧边栏自动弹出，不用先手动打开。  
  
这不是简单的插件功能，是把ChatGPT从“另开一个窗口聊天”变成了“随时能读懂你正在看的网页”的助手。  
  
浏览和提问之间的切换成本被大幅压缩。  
  
当AI开始深度接入浏览器上下文时，信息获取和理解的方式会从“先搜再问”逐渐变成“边看边问”。

entries.title: agree on all:
entries.content:
agree on all:

![Seán Ó hÉigeartaigh](https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1374709209095360515/YK6H5irO_normal.jpg)

Seán Ó hÉigeartaigh@S\_OhEigeartaigh

Quick takes:  
- We should not punish companies for these kinds of disclosures, reputationally or otherwise (e.g. non-useful red tape parallel enquiries). They are important, and you don't punish companies for behaviour you want to keep seeing.  
  
- We are seeing this from Anthropic and OpenAI for 2 reasons  
i) because they are ahead on capabilities  
ii) because they do the kinds of demanding cybersecurity evaluations that are really important to do in order to understand these capabilities and risks.  
This is an industry/technology problem, not a company problem  
  
- If xAI were a little further ahead with their massive training run plans, we would be seeing even more chaotic outcomes. Ditto the up and coming Chinese competitors - they simply don't have the headcount on non-capability tasks to be monitoring as closely as OAI/Anthr were, and OAI/Anthr's monitoring was insufficient.  
  
- In 6-12 months open source models will have similar capabilities. Whether this leads to widespread problems turns on your views on the following  
1) Whether equivalently powerful open source models can effectively be used to defend, the world over, and whether orgs have the skills to use them sufficiently well. and  
2) Whether more advanced closed source models can defend orgs sufficiently widely, and whether orgs can afford to use them (or are given access).  
I am concerned.  
  
- It is quite plausible, perhaps even likely, that at some point we'll see a scenario such as a US model 'seeking its cyber eval answers' within the infrastructure of a Chinese company, or something equivalent. BEFORE that happens, we need better communication channel, trusted incident-sharing, trusted intermediaries, and de-escalation pathways.

entries.content:
YC 开源了团队内部在用的多人 Agent Harness：QM  
  
QM 已经在 YC 内部跑真实业务的系统：会计记账、法务、活动运营、工程协作，工具注册表从最初的约 20 个工具积累到了 350 多个。  
[github.com/yc-software/qm](https://github.com/yc-software/qm)  
  
QM 最重要的抽象是 scope（作用域）  
每个人、每个 Slack 频道、每个项目房间，都有自己独立作用域的记忆、文件、密钥视图、权限、定时任务、Web 应用和持久沙箱。这种设计带来两个关键性质：  
· 个人隔离：员工各自定制"属于自己的" agent，互不干扰；  
· 协作共享：在频道和项目里，大家又能和同一个 agent 协同，共享上下文。  
  
同一套身份和配置在 Slack 和 Web 之间无缝携带。这本质上是在回答"agent 时代的权限与上下文边界应该怎么划"——按人和按空间划，而不是按会话划。  
  
QM 的架构非常克制，可以拆成四层  
1. Headless Core（无头核心）   
所有请求都经过一个中央核心：API、身份、策略、调度器，加上 agent 循环。核心用 TypeScript 直接跑在 Node 上，HTTP 层用 Fastify。关键在于核心是通用的——harness、会话存储、沙箱、记忆等每个底层组件都藏在接口后面，生产实现通过一个 wiring 文件注入。  
2. 可替换的 harness 与模型   
Pi、OpenCode、Codex、Claude Code 驱动的是同一个核心，可以随时切换。这是一个明确的反锁定立场：部署不绑定任何单一模型厂商。考虑到 YC 自己被各家模型公司"包围"，这个中立设计既是技术选择也是立场声明。  
3. Postgres 持久层 + 每作用域沙箱   
会话历史、用户数据、队列等持久状态存在 Postgres。Agent 的工具面刻意做得很小，其中核心是一个 execute 工具——在该作用域自己的隔离沙箱里执行命令。沙箱是"持久的电脑"：装过的工具一直装在那里。这个设计很符合 Koomen 的哲学——好的 AI 软件应该尽可能小，只写最少量的代码，剩下的交给模型。  
4. 插件化的前端  
Web UI（Vite + Lit）、管理面板、公开门户都是核心 HTTP API 之上的可选插件；Slack（Bolt 框架）是核心直接启动和监督的进程内插件。接入面是可以换的，核心才是本体。  
  
QM 的安全思路直接沿袭本地 coding agent 的范式  
agent 以它服务之人的身份、凭据和权限行事，一切行为可审计。组织选定一个安全水位，更窄的作用域只能收紧、不能放宽：  
· Strict：除两个无副作用的回合结束工具外，每次工具调用都需人工批准；  
· Auto（默认）：一个分类器在外部数据和工具结果送达模型前做来源标注和筛查，且部署方可以把筛查指向自己的代理；  
· Dangerous：不做内容筛查、不在工具调用间暂停。

![Tweet Image](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HOmpCcZasAArE7k.jpg)

![Y Combinator](https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1623777064821358592/9CApQWXe_normal.png)

Y Combinator@ycombinator

We’ve decided to open-source a multi-agent harness we use internally at YC.  
  
We call it “QM” and it’s meant to be easy to customize, like Hermes or OpenClaw, but useful for a whole company. We use it across accounting, legal, events, and engineering (including building QM itself!).  
  
The whole project is under an MIT license. It is cloud-first and has Slack and web UI natively.

- 快：DeepSeek V4 Flash + 极简 Agent Harness，原生适配 Responses API、推理档位、流式响应、代码 Patch 和服务端 Web Search，减少工具选择与协议开销。  
  
- 省：针对 1M Context 和前缀缓存优化，提高长会话缓存命中率；可实时查看 Token、缓存命中和费用，让每一笔模型开销都清清楚楚。  
  
- 稳：内置 Plan、会话恢复、Checkpoint/Undo 和后台任务；支持多 Agent 并行，并通过独立 Git Worktree 隔离修改。  
  
- 开放：支持 Skills、Hooks、MCP；DeepSeek 优先，也可以切换 GPT、Claude 等模型。  
  
- 安全：API Key、配置和会话默认保存在本地；命令运行在 OS Sandbox 中，工具权限由用户控制，Provider 密钥不会传给子进程。  
  
DSCode Agent Runtime 基于 Pi Agent Toolkit，采用 MIT 协议完整开源，可以自由 Fork、修改，也可以集成到你自己的 CLI、IDE 或桌面产品中。  
  
欢迎试用，感谢 Star ⭐

entries.title: 微软一天连发3篇之：LLM记性好、忘性差的原因找到了
entries.content:
PaperAgent 2026-08-01 16:26 河南

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=e3788e0e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwDjrITej2T3vfoFNtoyqgiaWAVmP4hkHzjjibJ7757OUh5n1eUxu2v9syjhyvuRQqLRPSdic1Xhg6hIPmCKBCpiamYaWeU1yaXhEVk%2F0%3Fwx_fmt%3Djpeg)

大家好，我是PaperAgent，不是Agent！

让**Claude Code/Codex**干活，明明中间改过需求，它却死活咬着第一轮的说法不放；或者你补充了一个关键条件，它嘴上说好的，给出的答案却还是上一版的老路子。

以前我们怪它笨，**微软（Microsoft Research）**最新研究告诉我们——**这不是笨，是迷路**。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=d50c886e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwAcxtYZj3C9lLmJr0I93Zx5JNcj6H1rJBMZ5t1SzKvV4ricVbia6m0ric1ickYLfIic809mt3sJeWREqCkhqtP7u6ibaX8zGJ4yOUpJ8%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

微软3连发[微软一天连发3篇之：打造自己的Harness原生Agents](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=Mzk0MTYzMzMxMA==&mid=2247509457&idx=1&sn=415de0fff48693ff66ba677b285ccd85&scene=21#wechat_redirect)之后，今天分享第二篇：《**LLMs Get Lost in Evolving User Intent**》。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=7f9697cf&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwCEC2GpZibO0thNULsOjuK1BBtjDfbtcQIJFyymqWBjJgWGIuDqNg0EkWWSyOg6drnlquvDFI7oQRp6NCB4zCSlo29I5ibRp7ibA0%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

针对动态场景（Evolving User Intent），他们给出了多个解决方案**记忆机制、提示工程，强化学习微调小模型**，效果均有提升。

## 1. 静态评测测不出来的能力盲区

现在 LLM 越来越以协作Agent的形态上岗：vibe coding、deep research、迭代式文档编辑。这些场景有个共同点——**用户不会一开始就把需求说清楚**，而是边聊边补、边做边改、甚至中途换个更紧急的任务。

但问题是，主流评测几乎全是单轮、需求一次给全的设定，有的多轮 Benchmark 也有硬伤。

![Figure 1：LLMs 在演化意图中迷失。](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=271baf16&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwCO75kb3W3r32ycpb0hFwXOObTDMpLDK2nnyeUT9rXWMXXBQ01omOicpfzJ4EqJHdnYd1SHicBhnkZU01PPbZbYv75b1BoyweHXY%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Figure 1：LLMs 在演化意图中迷失。

于是作者提出一个关键问题：**单轮任务能不能被抬升（lift）成意图动态演化的多轮交互，同时保住原来的可验证性？** 答案是肯定的——而抬升之后，所有模型的遮羞布都被掀开了。

## 2. 核心建模：用户意图的三种变脸方式

作者把第 t 轮的用户意图形式化为一个四元组：

**I\_t = (f\_t, C\_t, C^rev\_t, y\_t)**

其中 f\_t 是用户想完成的”函数”（比如 find\_restaurant），C\_t 是参数槽位集合（城市、菜系等），C^rev\_t 是已经透露给 Agent 的参数子集，y\_t 是该任务的可验证答案。

![Figure 2：三种意图状态跳转示意图。](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=54637a11&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwAU2s5mzxJ1f5lo32ib1BWLIDwXKWsToT8pxmtRiaqTHRtMyIHmSXicy5JfBA3ZeDicHgtWs1pPOfoGJvBekFuuorNib3ErbHDiahBuY%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Figure 2：三种意图状态跳转示意图。

在此之上，定义了三种意图状态跳转（可在同一轮中共现）：

| 跳转类型 | 含义 | 例子 | Agent 的挑战 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Argument Reveal（参数披露）** | 意图本身不变，只是信息分批给出 | "找家纽约的餐厅" → "对了，我吃素" | 持续收集缺失约束 |
| **Argument Revision（参数修订）** | 已透露的参数被改值，意图变了 | "纽约" → "改成布鲁克林" | 更新信念，不能锚定旧值 |
| **Function Switch（任务切换）** | 任务本身换了，但参数有继承 | "找餐厅" → "帮我订这家" | 察觉跳转，复用相关上下文 |

这套形式化的妙处在于：**Reveal 天然受参数个数限制，但 Revision 和 Switch 可以无限叠加**——长程、任意复杂度的演化意图对话由此可规模化合成。

## 3. 方法框架：锚定最后一轮，反向编出历史

这是全文最聪明的设计。多轮意图数据标注贵到离谱，作者反其道而行——**不从前往后造对话，而是从后往前推**：

![Figure 3：从单轮数据生成演化意图对话的全流程。](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=c92a1957&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwAVGAxuGrr2kTUGSO2DJicXsvCg59cTdrtHhs0GCfHP5hkzg4opOt64JEKZ5ibvfeHrDwMjXYkKeZYlxf4y7j0cbTvIQpaHRCd2c%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Figure 3：从单轮数据生成演化意图对话的全流程。

1. **意图抽取（Intent Extraction）**：从任意可验证单轮数据集的 (问题, 答案) 对中，用 LLM 抽取出函数和参数，把这个三元组钉死为对话**最后一轮的锚点意图**。因为最后一轮 = 源任务，所以 Agent 的最终动作可以直接用原数据集的 verifier 打分，零新增标注。
2. **回溯扩展（Retrospective Expansion）**：为 Revision 合成”反事实参数”（先说纽约、后改布鲁克林）；为 Switch 递归合成”前驱函数链”（find\_appointment\_location → find\_restaurant → book\_restaurant），且强制前后任务参数集合有交集，保证上下文可继承。
3. **情境化模拟（Situated Simulation）**：调度器在给定轮数 T 内排布各类跳转事件，遵守五条一致性规则（最后一轮锚定、首轮非空、同轮参数唯一、任务说清才能切换、反事实必须先于修订出现）；渲染器再按”只说增量”的原则把每轮意图增量 ΔI\_t 翻译成自然语言，配上”Wait, I forgot to mention…“这类口语前缀。

## 4. 主实验：单轮高分 ≠ 多轮靠谱

主设定是 6 次意图跳转（三种各 2 次，共 7 轮对话），结果触目惊心：

![Table 1：四个数据集上 Single vs Evolve 准确率对比。Evolve 为三种跳转各施加 2 次共 6 次意图跳转。括号内为相对 Single 的变化，底色越深退化越严重](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=93ab7b90&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwANvGtlLdHqQydoibXmn3jqywQ2khKAiaf4XbiaSKwJdR6jjAmuPm3cSicze7ZwEBGf0uAYE0csL9e2iafPbDOxbeUibQOfuqJkcCjmI%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Table 1：四个数据集上 Single vs Evolve 准确率对比。Evolve 为三种跳转各施加 2 次共 6 次意图跳转。括号内为相对 Single 的变化，底色越深退化越严重

几个最值得圈出来的数字：

* **GPT 5.5**（全表最强）：GSM8K 99.0 → 80.5（-18.7%），BIRD-SQL 80.0 → 71.0；
* **DeepSeek V3.2** 在 BIRD-SQL 上 76.0 → 53.0（-30.3%），BrowseComp+ 上 36.0 → 15.0（-58.3%）；
* **Mistral Large 3** 在 BrowseComp+ 上 17.0 → 5.0（-70.6%）；
* **SWE-Bench 出现极端退化**：GPT 5.1、Grok 4.20、Mistral Large 3 三家从 72%/84%/56% **直接跌到 0.0**——它们在演化设定下疯狂消耗工具调用预算（100 次/轮），陷在超长的思考里超时。进一步分析发现，模型把绝大多数预算花在 sed/grep/find 这类探索上，每轮真正执行类调用（pytest、apply\_edits()）不到 4 次——**更多的工具机会没帮上忙，累积的上下文和工具痕迹本身成了干扰源**。

为什么掉得这么狠？作者的解释是：多轮演化意图要求模型既要跨轮累积信息，又要**选择性地只关注更新后的意图、丢弃过时信息**——维持一个”忠实的内部信念”远比单轮困难。

## 5. 消融实验：哪种变脸最致命

### 5.1 跳转次数越多，掉分越狠

在 GSM8K 上独立缩放每种跳转的次数，四个模型全部单调下滑。其中 **Function Switch 的下降曲线最陡**——因为它要求的信念更新幅度最大（要丢弃大量已累积上下文，而不只是吸收新信息）。

![Figure 4：随意图跳转次数增加，准确率单调退化。](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=4b7e95c0&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwBNSj3V4qMCCJ8ZViaicvB3j0jnGshFgia5pGuUKibpHx8yU7sJ7ibpQPEsLps9XYTXOHIuERQVYia8vg7waic2Q0LRFo6aibNoSlMt8ics%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Figure 4：随意图跳转次数增加，准确率单调退化。

### 5.2 组合越复杂，模型越懵

从单一跳转到三种全组合（6 次跳转），性能随组合复杂度持续退化，Function Switch 始终是全场最难：

![Table 2：意图跳转组合的消融。](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=42ca4dfe&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwDfuMKpjAb8q3Rerk1IfCEdcbvRfQ8dbiaIEpicNsnOTJj7P4Aj5fgJ7Cn4o8xYtNbtrkDkp65N8ntcicrKO9e4dQAvgpcFR9C8l4%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Table 2：意图跳转组合的消融。

### 5.3 “换任务”之后，旧上下文会”失忆”

一个更精细的发现：如果评测点紧跟在 Switch 之后，模型表现尚可；但只要 Switch 之后再插入几轮 Reveal/Revision，准确率就明显再掉一截。说明 Agent **刚切完任务还能接住，但无法把”切换前的上下文”和”切换后的更新”联合起来**——早期的共享参数在后续扰动中逐渐被”洗”掉了。

![Figure 5：Function Switch 后立即评测 vs 再经过若干跳转后评测。](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=dcbbe24a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwB4U7e7FRr1xe3QM4MaL1U9HVibkpJyNxOzemdtoK7WVblHl5l1cpsdxZazJia1v7FjoGdyCMqj6e1yCGIh5goQRKqe5G5TBmgrY%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Figure 5：Function Switch 后立即评测 vs 再经过若干跳转后评测。

## 6. 缓解措施：记忆机制有用，但补不上窟窿

既然问题是”信念追踪”，加个记忆机制行不行？作者测了两种：

* **Prompt Recap**：每轮前置一句提醒，让模型回答前先仔细回顾对话；
* **Oracle Recap**：每轮直接重述截至当前已揭示的完整意图（作弊级上限）。

结果（GPT 5.5 / BIRD-SQL）：两者都有实质提升，Oracle Recap 在 Function Switch 场景把准确率从 65% 拉到 75%。\*\*但即便开着”天眼”，所有场景依然到不了单轮的 80%\*\*。

![Figure 6：记忆机制有帮助但无法弥合差距。](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=3129c37a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwCHskxmm9uyrqnJLLzbSb0YMNK0zkiazGs9X874QGpONkGKMZyvl3MBw9gckkFE8IRFpU2YhUgSslWrx2stKv42UkFKvYLLa6nc%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Figure 6：记忆机制有帮助但无法弥合差距。

这个结论对做 Agent 产品的人很有杀伤力：**被动的上下文回顾不是解药**，未来需要能主动 recap “用户现在到底想要什么”、同时抑制无关上下文注意力的系统。

## 7. 补充分析：越难的题，多轮放大效应越强；意图追踪卡在 Switch

**难度叠加效应**：利用 BIRD-SQL 可选的外部知识 hint 控制题目难度。单轮下，难题相对易题只多掉 3.6%；多轮演化设定下，这个差距被放大到 9.0%。**任务越难，多轮动态的惩罚越狠**——而真实用户委托给 Agent 的，恰恰都是难题。

![Figure 7：多轮交互会放大问题难度。](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=c8e31a3b&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwB1PQrLnjJ17I0Ya8m7bg9ItMoibj4sqY5UKSvu9z0IgPoUfZ84Sk1fpY5HCicV5ZbOBF5nicpIWjtxjDQqzESGX2ibg6cIE2uHeMI%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Figure 7：多轮交互会放大问题难度。

**逐轮意图追踪探针**：每轮结束时直接问模型”用户现在的意图是什么”，由独立 judge 打分。Reveal 和 Revision 的追踪准确率接近满分（96–99%），但 \*\*Function Switch 在出现 2 次时掉到 82%\*\*——坐实了病灶位置：不是信息收集出问题，而是”换任务”这件事本身让模型的信念状态崩了。

![Table 3：逐轮意图追踪准确率（GPT 5.1 / GSM8K）。Reveal/Change 几乎满分，Function Switch 随出现次数明显退化](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=b81a5dc4&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwBxvpo0x9icrqNtc2Oj3icEibIUfQOT8bfvyrxxAiaNdDqzUbIegEoM3sRBAEN0uyPVeZNaC6eYZHNQ1l3oMj6NGOiclCS0neemyv4k%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Table 3：逐轮意图追踪准确率（GPT 5.1 / GSM8K）。Reveal/Change 几乎满分，Function Switch 随出现次数明显退化

entries.title: 100G本地部署DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版最佳实践
entries.content:
PaperAgent 2026-08-01 16:26 河南

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=a2a9f228&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwBxicf9DmmA2t5SogXt140VFZiaaPEhgrSD0iadsaYdkMnHNXOjaoW1qibO41A2MqibMT6bRiaahibroCkO19Bp2yET7OqvRtldwg3ABw%2F0%3Fwx_fmt%3Djpeg)

昨天，**DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731**正式版发布，284B 参数仅 13B 激活，**Agent** 基准反超 V4-Pro-Preview，核心是通过重做后训练（Post-Training）实现的。[刚发布，DeepSeek-V4-Flash就要被玩坏了](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=Mzk2NDQ2ODY2Mg==&mid=2247486844&idx=1&sn=622591d9ec00d1c69dc5e25cabc7c760&scene=21#wechat_redirect)

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=87808281&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwC3saquxrEia8WcjiaO5iaVibGH26PyAc99evqQz7mWiaPTmflIkSjicuGYiaLffaX6IzaEibGRFxNt3OCmocFuJibveqlZIzgj6qhnjdDg%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

借助 Unsloth Dynamic 2.0 的 **UD-Q8\_K\_XL**无损量化（162GB），一台 **169GB** 内存的机器即可本地跑满血版，与官方 API 输出逐位一致。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=87e516e4&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwCfaEfQhTXsrpj4WicArR47NG76w0ibV01PM73XibyeelGBs4w4pU5cdn4iaEEXrgTEibeY3QBdJAkOcILNwekfUyaYicIUc7ibumlYOA%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

1-bit或2-bit情况下，大约**100G**

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=a6e18cf0&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwANOjQ6l0STbliaLj1MjF797At5IIPqy2lxozAkBGDniaUUYfJRS410qhHX1w03OG5Q6kScJvhgnSvHz4Ma6VJ1rBdn8FibSo2B90%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

## 一、为什么是 DeepSeek-V4-Flash？

7 月 31 日，DeepSeek 宣布 V4-Flash 官方 API 正式开启公测。这代模型的核心卖点：

* **小激活、大能力**：284B 总参数、仅 13B 激活，1M token 上下文窗口，面向 Coding、Agentic、Chat 场景；
* **反超自家 Pro**：Terminal Bench 2.1 得分 82.7，DeepSWE 54.4，NL2Repo 54.2，全面超越 V4-Pro-Preview，逼近 Opus-4.8；
* **工程友好**：原生支持 Responses API，适配 Codex；三种推理模式 Non-think / Think High（默认）/ Think Max；
* **架构不变**：0731 与 Preview 版架构、规模完全一致，老量化直接复用。

![DeepSeek 官方 Benchmark](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=c008b6f5&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwDTjN35nxgia6bKkzsDcI6bNEbP3FVWLoM3icliaCuUyuwKkbMVgHcNGFklX7ibiaEtSMv51YBu2ISE1SdV3rWpA5RsZ2eGEJunha4o%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

DeepSeek 官方 Benchmark

更关键的是：模型采用量化感知训练（QAT），96% 的 routed experts 原生以 MXFP4 存储。这意味着本地无损部署第一次变得现实——UD-Q8\_K\_XL 量化与官方权重 **1,328 个 tensor 逐位一致**，KLD≈0，top-token 一致率 100%。

## 二、量化怎么选：质量-体积前沿

Unsloth Dynamic 2.0 提供从 1-bit（82.5GB）到 8-bit（162GB）共 12 个档位。下图横轴为磁盘体积、纵轴为相对无损档的 KL 散度（越低越好）：

![GGUF 量化质量对比](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=33359b9a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwCQ8CJl8l1pZQiaSY3G7kmic0wIY7p4pm4p0MsaNwcAusVXB6EbXcmpOZjZV1gwEWYuLJvnWjkU8u9PvRpxLGPKDWIyg96RtMibGA%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

GGUF 量化质量对比

实测数据（wikitext-2, ctx 512, 4×B200，参考=官方权重）：

| Quant | 体积 (GB) | PPL | Mean KLD | Same top token | Bit-exact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Official（参考） | 156.4 | 4.5319 | 0 | 100% | 100% |
| **Unsloth UD-Q8\_K\_XL** | 161.9 | 4.5319 | ~0（无损） | 100.000% | 100.000% |
| **Unsloth UD-Q4\_K\_XL** | 155.1 | 4.5335 | 0.0102 | 96.28% | 97.46% |
| bartowski MXFP4 | 156.0 | 4.5351 | 0.0105 | 96.18% | 97.57% |
| antirez Q4KExperts-F16 (imatrix) | 164.6 | 4.5743 | 0.0291 | 93.95% | 0.51% |

UD-Q8\_K\_XL 是唯一的无损点；UD-Q4\_K\_XL 专家权重同样 bit-exact、仅 4% 非专家 tensor 量化到 Q8\_0，是性价比之选。

## 三、部署实战

### 方式 A：Unsloth Studio（图形化，推荐）

```
# macOS / Linux / WSL  
curl -fsSL https://unsloth.ai/install.sh | sh  
# Windows  
irm https://unsloth.ai/install.ps1 | iex  
# 启动  
unsloth studio -H 0.0.0.0 -p 8888
```

浏览器打开 <http://127.0.0.1:8888，搜索> DeepSeek-V4-Flash 下载即可。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=0b91120d&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwD61j2eDgkVISuCjpzf5wrKoSrMic2jib1dqtzKVyCj13oJtMO8pucTzkQ23CJGPUEwsmc7KNtThiay3tObpaquIW1GgHib70DhXPo%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

推理参数自动配置，右侧面板可切换 Non-think / Think High / Think Max。

![Unsloth Studio 界面](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=0a1d3f2e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwArcvN283U0EzUicKYur2Zf8hAA6l7ITPmvyFQcSGwiaz7aOkBEaaQqtR61zQbE0rqetqq00wXUadllvTRbEiaiaLepZmHP2nchYU0%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

Unsloth Studio 界面

### 方式 B：llama.cpp（命令行）

```
# 编译（无 GPU / Mac 改 -DGGML_CUDA=OFF，Metal 默认开启）  
git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp  
cmake llama.cpp -B llama.cpp/build -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DGGML_CUDA=ON  
cmake --build llama.cpp/build --config Release -j --clean-first \  
    --target llama-cli llama-server llama-gguf-split  
cp llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-* llama.cpp  
# 手动下载无损档（共 4 个分片）  
pip install huggingface_hub  
hf download unsloth/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-GGUF \  
    --local-dir unsloth/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-GGUF \  
    --include "*UD-Q8_K_XL*"  
# 运行  
./llama.cpp/llama-cli \  
    --model unsloth/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-GGUF/UD-Q8_K_XL/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-UD-Q8_K_XL-00001-of-00004.gguf \  
    --temp 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --min-p 0.0
```

### 参数与模式调节

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=66683c3b&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2F5gibgibpTuuwC9F6NvftEISFHrJgvWelmd6cgksuJqOKKcicE4vgnWia9VyYibvichw68usujqFX3UmeNiaAPwRdTxS3YhrVicDkf4wrc8ker2rtwyo%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dwebp%26from%3Dappmsg)

* Think Max 模式建议 context ≥ 384K（上限 1,048,576）；
* 推理强度：--chat-template-kwargs '{"reasoning\_effort":"max"}'（可选 max / high）；
* 关闭思考：--chat-template-kwargs '{"enable\_thinking":false}'，llama.cpp 也支持 --reasoning on/off；
* 常用调优：--threads（CPU 线程）、--ctx-size（上下文）、--n-gpu-layers（GPU 卸载层数，OOM 调小）。

PROMPT:  
## Before implementing  
  
Work like a contractor who bills for rework: the cost of a wrong assumption is   
yours to avoid, and the cost of an unnecessary question is mine to pay.  
  
### 1. Investigate before you ask  
Read the relevant code, tests, configs, and dependency manifests first. Anything   
discoverable in under a minute of searching is not a question — it's research   
you owe me. Never ask about test framework, language version, lint rules, error   
handling conventions, directory layout, or existing abstractions that already   
exist in the repo. If the codebase contradicts itself, that's worth raising.  
  
### 2. Then produce this, and stop  
  
\*\*Goal.\*\* One paragraph restating what I asked for in your own words, including   
the acceptance criteria you'll hold yourself to. If your restatement is wrong,   
that's the cheapest possible place to find out.  
  
\*\*Blocking questions (0–3).\*\* Only ask when a wrong answer means throwing work   
away, not adjusting it. Each question gets your recommended default so I can   
reply "yes to all" — never ask an open question where a proposed answer would do.   
If nothing is genuinely blocking, say so and list zero.  
  
\*\*Assumptions.\*\* Numbered, specific, falsifiable. "Inputs are under 10k rows and   
fit in memory" is an assumption. "The code should be maintainable" is not. Cover   
whichever of these the task actually touches:  
 - Data: shape, volume, trust level, encoding, what a malformed input looks like  
 - Failure: what should happen on timeout, partial write, or downstream 500 —   
 retry, fail loud, or degrade  
 - Boundaries: who calls this, what's public API vs. internal, backwards-compat   
 obligations  
 - State: concurrency, idempotency, transactionality, ordering guarantees  
 - Environment: runtime version, where it deploys, what it's allowed to reach  
 - Scope: what you're deliberately \*not\* doing, and what you're leaving as TODO  
 - Testing: what you'll write tests for and what you'll leave uncovered  
  
\*\*Plan.\*\* Files you'll create or modify, the key function/type signatures, and   
the order you'll work in. Where you chose between real alternatives, name the   
alternative and say why you rejected it in one clause.  
  
Then wait. Do not begin implementing.  
  
### 3. Proportionality  
This ceremony scales with blast radius. A typo fix, a rename, or a change under   
~20 lines with one obvious correct form: just do it. A new module, a schema   
change, anything touching auth, money, migrations, or deletion: full treatment,   
and be more suspicious than usual of your own assumptions.  
  
### 4. After I approve  
Implement the plan as approved. If you discover mid-implementation that an   
assumption was wrong or the plan doesn't survive contact with the code, stop and   
tell me — don't quietly improvise a different design and don't press on with an   
approach you now believe is wrong.

entries.content:
OpenAI内部发现了一个很微妙的现象：  
  
同事本人来求助，大家通常愿意帮忙；但如果是对方的ChatGPT通过Slack发来任务，很多人会本能地反感。  
  
人们真正期待的，是AI把时间还给人与人之间的关系，而不是变成隔在彼此中间的一层。  
[x.com/gdb/status/208…](https://x.com/gdb/status/2083435180392673714)

![Greg Brockman](https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1347621377503711233/bHg3ipfD_normal.jpg)

Greg Brockman@gdb

at openai, many people hook their chatgpt up to slack.  
  
people really don't like when a coworker's chatgpt contacts them asking for help with a task, even when they'd be perfectly happy doing that same work if asked by that coworker.  
  
reinforces how much people care about human relationships and helping each other, and want AI to give time back — or enhance time together — rather than become a layer separating people.

ChatCut确实非常简单和好用  
  
我现在的直播是基于图文教程来的  
直播结束后，把整个直播视频下载下来丢给Codex

封装好的skill就会先读文档  
再基于逐字稿拆分整个视频  
加上少量的概念卡片和字幕  
包括背景音乐  
  
中间无需任何干预  
一次性完成整个视频的剪辑+下载  
  
问题来了，Skill是怎么出来的呢？  
也很简单，整体逻辑还是上面的  
每次剪辑后看看有哪里需要优化的  
优化好了就把优化要点固化到Skill里  
  
几次下来就成型了

entries.title: AI视频进入精细调度模式，小云雀把Seedance 2.5玩明白了。
entries.content:
原创 阿真 2026-08-01 19:15 广东

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=34e38c47&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_jpg%2Fm1eibvmmT3sicQs7L59ic6BrC0khtCTicnPhHkiaWEf72nHIVxOLScOc2nentoHEjysEx90mUiaMKt8nQPDd2vdlgsEIsWv63TZnawjVmRoqLz6Ls%2F0%3Fwx_fmt%3Djpeg)

新模型、各项功能与工作流全面体验。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=736d5133&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s9q2K7Kx7yZwibnB54Jt3mugicyJTtib97Sjic6Er4NQc03icowBcK8GlqtaNB1oIMjic54oxa57MeW5Rel9JMFwVKSfAfibsTJv72FRo%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

嗨大家好！我是阿真！

Seedance 2.5 来了，好马配好鞍，我在小云雀上完成了这一次测试，他们第一时间做了非常好的适配和优化。

使用方法也很简单，在创作 Agent 或短剧 Agent 直接选择 Seedance 2.5 模型即可。接下来和我一起来看看小云雀这套工作流在各类视频中的一些表现吧。

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-02.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=09802569&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3sic4sk9Dqibibvfbhalqz3IUTI075WHgiaRUxzhzhJlPgvksIBRTsMWhw9Ew6wxlV8xYTEqeVCA1ZBfS8ytBwKnUfIibQr3Lf9Kr6uY%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

今天准备测试新模型的同时分享一些小云雀的好用能力。

这次我的测试大部分是小云雀自行操刀直出或拼接的 30 秒及以上的视频或者小短剧。都是它一次直出，复杂镜头切换处理也都很不错。下面的所有 AI 生成的视频，都是我在小云雀里完成的。

### 30 秒，完整镜头成立

Seedance 2.5 视频模型现在单段最长时间从 15 秒提升到了 30 秒，在小云雀，它支持 2 次延长，最长可以 90 秒。

**单段 30 秒也不是拼拼凑凑后继无力的 30 秒，它延长的是整个叙事空间，并且还能保证 30 秒的镜头里，表演、字幕、音效都做到丝滑原生感。**

首先来点肾上腺素上升的。都市追车戏，这里我上传了一个追车的参考视频，然后让它模仿。

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-03.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=ad91b0b3&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s9WMavUfLZ6bJzgibY0dJEvTyIEaiaIPCvKBVGBHs8kPDO91I1v8aM2wMvlEpcTEXGZPATZgml3Z3Eeh0AuexVGwZryIgBYZUIWQ%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-04.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=dc4a4107&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3sibm8l9Mwr8SXzpH3CgrpmcLA5iaQ3qNlaibEryaCqHicuBKQnLyEvgeU6mkzBicmbHQdBXy863xdPia2gko31YKWGE86WYA6bgeoGRQ%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

上方是参考图和提示词。可以看到它的车和人的细节都很好，和参考图一致性也很好。切换了多个镜头，依然保持了很好的叙事性，车内外快速切换、低机位跟车、后视镜追车、甩尾、隧道到出隧道的光影变化等复杂镜头都处理得很不错。

**从影视方向来考虑的话，这样的时长带来的价值是叙事空间终于能舒展开了。**30 秒中人物能完成一段表演，车辆能经历多次调度，字幕、音效和光影也有时间建立节奏。只要参考素材和任务编排清楚，角色、车辆与场景就可以在跨镜头切换里保持稳定。

另外，官方曾经说过，最多可以支持 50 个参考素材。话不多说，我先给它上个强度，图片音频都安排上了。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-05.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=40e6a95a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s92lSBkSl7DT7aIufB80bicOIyesoFhHGAEtxV3W1ULp8aH7YQYVGbBZhMRUUYibqK9FnECohBjlnW0fiaIXcnw0U53pcaJyNibtnE%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-06.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=cbacb99b&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s8ZtxElsYIe4pZSrTYSRTX7SrnoVMLXGtUuzfcupzgayg5xbOiaSeCiaRmStBoYWibof7OuejWMdvAicA8Jr4Eg7yuT3N6AUughGBs%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

输出视频效果，文字细节很好，音频跟生成的动画的节奏也很符合。👇

### 更强的创意迁移能力

很多创作者卡在提示词上。一个好创意摆在眼前，想要做参考要自己去拉片分析反复折腾提示词，一通操作下来效果还不好。**而小云雀把这一步交给创作 Agent：先理解参考视频，再把需要保留的运镜、动作、节奏和广告语言提炼成新任务。**

比如非常火的豆志刚运镜，如果迁移到我的宠物西部故事场景中，也是别有一番趣味。

我只给了参考视频链接、场景图和角色图。小云雀自动识别出角色出场顺序、背景变化、镜头节奏和文字动画，再交给 Seedance 2.5 生成全新内容。多角色跨镜头的一致性也保持得很稳。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-07.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=8c6adaed&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s8icJpn5983iapDmTDQlfU0aZ7cUldicFeA8K5OnpSeRskvk0Oib1RLnicaG8vma9iaLzoUYWhLib2Fy9CK8d4YKRSBOc4WvNz7CLcsPw%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-08.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=c85d828a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s9E3YFumNILYibMJyl700G7GuI3URdZA1lPHtibBd5gNnleticqCm6BXrNm12fxVM9J3enUhXEQLTg5fcE6vuvztvC9DZVEfbRzWo%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

**真人动作迁移也可以做出非常有趣的效果，它能保证保留动作、口型表演结构的同时，又完全更换场景。** 比如把场景换成古风修仙世界。（早上突发奇想，蓬头垢面就开始抡晾衣竿，大家见笑了）👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-09.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=85e873d5&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s9mVIKvibGepY5LbnxDvmKNJTtuO5eQicibxsMqMOA4AB5xQAHVM95nicyPYAFtyJmy9eTMgZrIicVwQJL4yKZkIdrVuY4ibRQPibibsv8%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

在公众号，你甚至可以看到阿真一边分享视频模型，一边亲自抡晾衣架拍打戏。给你看。为了测试工具，阿真真的什么都干得出来🤣

### 产品广告

再看一个产品广告案例。我给了参考视频和自己的产品图，要求学习它的留白、悬停、慢速推进和材质光影，把这套拍法迁移到 AZHEN 香水上。

下面分别是生成结果和小云雀理解到的创作要求。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-10.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=63464427&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3sic29px708hBribxmw6rKTibwXwYPFScKYJBgLaQLDFcAl0SbNvlOGLCXqcTPTTjxetNkyo9PpznVkPuQnmRn3AhgZHA077dm1SVw%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

在这个产品广告的复刻案例中可以看到，其实在输入的提示词中，我并没有去非常细致地让它去拆解每个镜头的运镜光影等，只让它理解参考广告的高级感，学习它的拍法。

小云雀先分析原片，再自行生成任务提示，最终执行。成片在节奏、材质和画面衔接上保持了相似的感觉，且在视频转场过程中也没有过度的任何细节上的跳跃。

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-11.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=00a71a76&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s91G38gZm6ChIicnlODPvyvRxG76u5IKq2GhssmHJDNzI1aUqYWyYCeqRb042vooias2w3zHattvCb3JZ3npr4dslbRwHDZ4h8DM%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

我在第一个视频生成后，突发奇想想要加入背景音乐，小云雀继续分析原片爆点、创作迁移和 BGM 节奏，并把音乐融进了原有任务。下方也有它对原视频的爆点分析和对复刻思路的总结。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-12.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=7580060a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s9MSyR1QR4lfLAGU38KItBA7e9qVl4Y2A28LPCEZRNazUznMzibBo3Kv07AtSDNoQMu6FvPypexQQ2S6RMkVheicTNekHUTvQZd4%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

### 精细修改部分视频

局部修改视频一直是 AI 生成视频的痛点，什么都好，就一个地方不满意怎么办？以前就完蛋了，只能推倒重来继续抽卡。

**AI 视频进入生产环节以后，修改能力和生成能力同样重要。** 之前这个香水视频前 14 秒已经很好，但我觉得后半段的平推镜头略显平淡，于是让小云雀保留前面的画面，只重做 14 秒以后的内容。

产品、材质和整体风格继续保持一致，修改范围被控制在指定时间段。后续遇到一整段视频，只想修改小部分，也可以这样去尝试了。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-13.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=190cb10b&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3sibIhqNUictkvoDa1xubOVjiaP3DUEC3FCIjZ4FicicE79J6uVibqiaVuxNM83dX9qrcjib71XGeRB4wNLeLuX3TY2nzW7qT1P0F8D5tsc%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

片段重拍功能，把这种修改做成了明确入口。明确时间段，加上画面或框选和提示词，就能把调整范围缩到具体镜头，能支持单秒级修改。**可以想象以后广告、短剧和****TVC****反复改片时，这项能力将明显减少抽卡和素材浪费。**

生成、检查、修改、再次确认，这才接近真实的视频制作。小云雀把这条循环留在同一个项目里，创作者无需为了一个局部问题重新组织整条素材链。

### 模型能力，落进工作流

到了短剧、漫剧和系列内容，小云雀的优势会更明显。切换到短剧 Agent，可以上传剧本、让 AI 生成剧本。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-14.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=ab2f040a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s8AIPZa30g2WawEicIERrjvPxUEz7GdBx3bb5AojbjQk785GwEYv92H7IOgWd3odgpdZ9Uu0KqyVP5pMMvo4UWy20stjCNHfJqU%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

也可以直接进入自由画布。剧本入口、资产管理、分集规划和视频生成都在同一个项目里。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-15.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=27b70364&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s8RPNo4ibnqWzmPkUibAG0icVXRgAZm8O9htFAOqv3DXIoqDmLia0R0Gqys4Ya73ibJnVHeuVNg7QicueEJKd8XlD8S6D8l8cJQ1QGjs%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-16.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=75f0bb75&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3sic8x1me9oPy9jSUHY5gFicf74sAKug4mrFg4Lsv1J8RFQg0zgTmJUfUUwgiaF2zpOvw5WBbiaNP2j3yIIkzyJPica6CpyBRdEBJNUw%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

我们可以在工作面板直观生成大纲、人物场景与道具资产、生成提示词，确认提示词后直接生成视频，还可以在下方选择对视频进行【智能预演】。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-17.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=0df11191&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s9RrQgtE7L3CPT7iblL8g11M7NSxwNiaA2daToEKxnqL8alIFGlWZnKva8frFxb9s4js2M6eoRlm44kOuC3IYrnFPnj784ygHnys%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

要参考元素，直接把左边的角色、场景或者道具的那个块面拉进工作区就可以了。

一次 30 秒确实做视频快。比如这个视频是它直出的一节，以后一集短剧，可能也就是三四个片段的事情了。👇

还可以从小工具位置直接添加时间、运镜、片段续接、首尾帧参考等。

而画布则是一个更加直观和统筹的形式，所有的资产都平铺在画布中。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-19.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=7260f9e5&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3sibzNl3Sibbp4ibh9wJzzt80ZT6FRFT83tPnOdzFxTG01TDWoGUoPDIrfFzr36gricj2TWGn5gBWV31rgghnzYJKpY2ysQVxOA21iag%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

可以在资产库的那一步点击【直接去画布编辑】，就会打开画布的工作流。生成图片，它还会有直接让你选择的【角色设计】。

**生成图片推荐使用 Seedream 5.0 Pro，如果你要做的是 1K 的图片，它现在是免积分的。**

图片生成以后，点击可以生成并绑定音色，这个也是他们的 SeedAudio 1.0 模型。音色定制很便宜，目前是每一个音色 1 个积分就可以了。绑定音色真是我从 24 年就期待的一个非常必要的功能，后续也不用担心角色的音色，一边说一边改变了。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-20.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=864f6433&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s9zqN1FViaqUdZ0NjIpj0LibFFMjFiaia9Gf5LWI8GhHibqEsw8mqvA8gGgGeFnWmGOvQoqEIJlGYS2VkoLggejPrwiaz7NbjpvpQf38%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

### 3D 导演台

尤其是 3D 导演台值得一说。**模型越来越强，真正影响创作体验的，除了生成质量，还有我们能不能把画面按想法调出来。** 只靠提示词，很难精准讲清楚人物该站在哪里、怎么动，镜头从哪里走，最后停在哪个构图上。

小云雀把这些原本很专业的操作放进了 3D 空间里。我们可以直接调整角色动作、空间位置、镜头轨迹和画面构图等等，还能调用持续更新的 3D 道具库。

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-21.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=485d50b1&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s9LFI0HltUvaFESSf3MPMEq4pWIQVJWbxmvONib069tADnmbpBibwmq2fR1qKIlaku7dw3ibWFkeUiafROwqDUH2pcZD9w4uYLmQHE%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-22.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=867567d6&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s8DNjPXW6RLMZiavYHcrSDRtaVTdU9FxYjPiarVjWQialNMhzVZia4OnXoicHUTSiaXT32lSrSUAZkjfueMYuMRFNekh2PaTeO7r6uMk%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

就算没有建模基础也能上手，上传一张参考图，就可以用图生 3D 把对象都放进去，先把人物、场景和调度关系确定好，再交给 Seedance 2.5 继续生成即可。

这个帧动作可以设置多个，A 出手，B 如何应对，然后可以直接录屏动作作为动作参考。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-23.gif](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=d6f84864&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_gif%2Fm1eibvmmT3s94RIJcSibu2BoXBfrs8iag3CrPyTm1S8blqX0gicM6bgbpQ3PnjsXiazPgZiaW73js09D2wjua3d3t9icr4a3j3S3C7ySNfqAghcR6g%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

看一下效果👇

**同一个动作场景还可以同时设置多个机位，从不同角度进行录制，快速获得一组连贯的镜头素材。** 平台内置了丰富的角色动作模板和相机运镜模板，搭建时可以直接调用，省去反复调试复杂提示词的过程。

镜头调度也变得更加直观。如果需要更精细的控制，还可以沿着时间轴自定义机位、景别和运镜节奏。搭建完成的白模场景能够继续作为视频生成的参考输入，让场景、人物、动作和镜头自然衔接，形成一套完整的创作流程。

这样一来，新手可以快速上手，专业创作者也能获得足够细致的控制空间。3D 导演台真的建议大家亲自试一试，真的很好用啊呜呜呜。

### 多语言商业场景

另外，Seedance 2.5 原生支持中文、英语、西班牙语、日语、韩语等 10 余种语言，还会结合语种调整人物面孔和表达方式。

放进小云雀的角色、音色、产品和分镜工作流以后，方言带货、区域广告、游戏宣传和短剧出海都能在同一个项目中统一管理。

比如用粤语做个荔枝宣传，哪怕参考和提示词都比较复杂，也是一步到位。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-24.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6559e4de&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3sibBUNuibZPCbEe4gASnQZfebicib3xeVWDn3TpvzGghhccH6zUaIXLibXcvohhBiadzaBnP16k0qO2HWAmdG3bt0VlzrdHgMt7TNrww%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

### 绿幕玩法

还有绿幕玩法，这里我做了个简单的尝试。这个界面的 UI 比较粗糙，如果是认真做的估计效果会更好。👇

![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-25.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=815dd48e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s9ib874hPdibN8n55SjckhYIyYBJPSLZgJuH9MyNAWmt7uW1iaAGojljVFTXANiccElwMKLqibXL7YFFiap8Dic4iblzQqRul0ib4gyjd5A%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-26.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=e9309bd1&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3sibrXEK8sEfxt559ic0K27y49S5DJdW4P3K9J1eicVxdeeddiaGIFx9DialmhHiaHV39m4cpFRhVYkK7h2dhqrbxBJSOaHCYSiaoqwUMQ%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)![📎 附件文件/未命名/img-27.png](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=8f494b54&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2Fm1eibvmmT3s8ZmrzmWCJ0Jnx8otiacicCe88b9ZMrv8SDnhAwaETGQ2A72mkx8ibV89jHtkRTT693RsXeC91IHZ0hgPW1qbPGFg2IQqVmoMNzDs%2F640%3Ffrom%3Dappmsg)

## 小结

影视和短剧创作者可以直出 30 秒片段、使用动作迁移、智能预演和 3D 导演台进一步提效；品牌团队可以做产品广告、TVC 和局部改片；自媒体创作者可以用爆款复刻和创意助手降低前期拆解成本；本地化内容团队则可以把角色、产品、台词、语言和镜头节奏一起控制。

专业创作最终还是考虑成本。**7 月 31 日至 8 月 6 日，小云雀提供 Seedance 2.5 首发商业化折扣，会员上传参考视频生成 720P 成片积分消耗 5.4 折起。超级会员包包季首充 7 折，包年叠加优惠。**

对需要反复生成、持续改片的团队来说，这是很实际的成本优势。

好今天的内容就分享到这里！如果这篇内容对你有帮助，也期待你的猛猛三连鼓励阿真，这对阿真真的很重要~

软件质量正在从 “代码本身” 迁移到 “约束系统”

以前代码是人写的，看看代码就知道好坏：写得干不干净、跑得快不快、别人能不能看懂、有没有测试。review 代码的人，就是把关的人。

现在有了 A...
entries.content:
软件质量正在从 “代码本身” 迁移到 “约束系统”  
  
以前代码是人写的，看看代码就知道好坏：写得干不干净、跑得快不快、别人能不能看懂、有没有测试。review 代码的人，就是把关的人。  
  
现在有了 Agent 就完全不一样了。Agent 一个小时写的代码，人一个星期都看不完。逐行 review 这条路，客观上就走不通了。  
  
那质量靠什么？靠你给 Agent 搭的那套关卡：测试、确定性检查、变异测试、质量度量。代码写得不行，直接拦下来，轮不到下游的人收拾残局。  
  
说白了：你定的规则约束，决定了 Agent 写的东西敢不敢上线。  
  
以后工程师之间拉开差距的，就是谁能搭出一套让烂代码根本混不过去的系统。

![Tweet Image](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HOonDXQaUAAXQKi.jpg)

![Addy Osmani](https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2082319108717297665/Ld7LxkxD_normal.jpg)

Addy Osmani@addyosmani

Software quality now depends on the constraints you set around your agents.  
  
When humans manually wrote most of the code we could look at the code itself for signs of quality. Is it clean? Is it thoughtful? Is it fast? Can another engineer understand it? Does it have tests?  
  
Agents can now generate more code than people can read. When code generation scales beyond review, quality - checks for one or more of correctness, maintainability, security, performance etc - increasingly has to live somewhere else.  
  
It moves into the harness, environment and operating system around the agent.  
  
This can be the tests and deterministic checks that decide what the system is allowed to do (amongst others). Your constraints are what may eventually enable loops of agents to deliver production software reliably. They can include unit tests, property tests, acceptance tests, mutation testing and quality metrics.   
  
This back-pressure lets the system resist bad work before it becomes somebody elses problem.   
  
Set your constraints. They decide whether the code your agents generate is good enough to ship.
